# Proper names the English-only guard must not police.
#
# The guard exists so that project text (docs, code, comments, metadata) is written in
# English. A person's name is not project text: transliterating it would misspell it. One
# name per line, matched literally, and a scan hit whose line contains one of these is
# removed before the guard decides. Add a line only for a real person or account name.
